purpose: one baseline through the runner's existing training and validation contract on the accepted ab-wildfire-ia-escape artifact, plus the pre-registered model-vs-triad deciding check on identical eval rows

artifact.name: ab-wildfire-ia-escape
artifact.split_description: temporal split on the assessment instant (America/Edmonton local operational time): train 2006-2015, eval 2016-2020, holdout 2021-2025, by the assessment instant's calendar year (356 winter carryover fires assessed in the year after their record year move with their assessment); population is ALL assessed Forest Protection Area wildfires (27,828), winter rows kept; label = final area burned >= 100 ha

deciding_check.rule: headroom is demonstrated ONLY if the runner-contract model beats EVERY triad member (persistence analogue = assessment_hectares, calendar/identity prior) with a day-clustered paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero in the model's favour, and its own AUC CI lies entirely above 0.5 for the degenerate constant member; triad dominance -> recorded defect, drop or re-target; no re-tuning after any score

majority_constant.treatment: constant member, no ranking information; beaten iff the model's day-cluster-bootstrap AUC CI lies entirely above 0.5

supplementary_model_vs_logistic_referenc.note: supplementary only: both are models, so this is not a deciding member; the pre-registered rule compares the model against the baselines above

deciding_check.scope: eval split only (assessment years 2016-2020); the sealed holdout (2021-2025) was not evaluated and no holdout figure exists or is implied

scope: runner-contract baseline + deciding check only; no agent loop, no holdout evaluation. Holdout stays sealed until the design is frozen.
